meta.name: systematic-debugging
meta.description: Systematic debugging process for any error, test failure, or unexpected behavior. Investigate root cause BEFORE proposing a fix.

copy.tagline: 系统排查任何错误或异常行为的根因
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果遇到错误或异常行为，需要先找到根因再修复。
copy.tagline_en: Systematically investigate root cause of any error or unexpected behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you encounter errors or unexpected behavior and need to find root cause before fixing.

howto.what: 遇到技术问题时，Claude 会先调查根本原因，再提出修复方案。它遵循四个阶段：调查原因、分析模式、提出假设并测试、实施修复。
howto.when: 当遇到测试失败、生产错误、意外行为、性能问题、构建失败或集成问题时触发。尤其在时间紧迫或看似简单的问题时，强制使用此流程。

say.text: 这个测试一直失败，帮我按系统调试流程找出根本原因。
say.note: Claude 会先调查原因，不直接给修复方案。

say.text: 我遇到了一个生产错误，请执行系统调试流程。
say.note: Claude 会从读取错误信息开始，逐步分析。

say.text: 之前试过几次修复都没成功，帮我用系统调试重新分析。
say.note: Claude 会检查是否达到3次修复上限，并考虑架构问题。

howto.what_en: When encountering a technical problem, Claude will first investigate the root cause before proposing a fix. It follows four phases: root cause investigation, pattern analysis, hypothesis and test, and implementation.
howto.when_en: Triggered for test failures, production errors, unexpected behavior, performance issues, build failures, or integration problems. Especially when under time pressure or when the problem seems simple.

say_en.text: This test keeps failing. Help me find the root cause using the systematic debugging process.
say_en.note: Claude will investigate first, not propose a fix directly.

say_en.text: I have a production error. Please run the systematic debugging process.
say_en.note: Claude will start by reading error messages and gathering evidence.

say_en.text: I've tried several fixes but none worked. Re-analyze using systematic debugging.
say_en.note: Claude will check if 3+ fixes failed and consider architectural issues.
